answer: Admit through one metered inlet with a fixed global intake per epoch, by an unpredictable staked lottery. The cap tracks real demand, not applicant count, so flooding keys only lowers each key's odds and raises the stake to win. A dormant relic account must re-enter the same lottery with no legacy priority. Winners post a slow-vesting bond slashed on duplication; a violet audit publishes each draw and its funding roots, collapsing same-root entrants. An operator wanting many seats must out-stake honest newcomers for each; cost rises with seats held, and no island of clones buys extra intake.
